_about: API-03 viewer isolation scans (tools/api-rules.mjs idLiteralBreaks, styleSelectorBreaks). One entry per break: reason, review finding (docs/architecture/api-review-2026-11-01.md), Objective expected to remove it. `id`: a fixed element id literal in src/shell or src/app. `selector`: `file.css: selector` for a selector in any stylesheet under packages/astraeus/src (derived, not listed) that is not under the viewer's root class (.astraeus-shell) or that names :root, html, body or #app. An entry that no longer matches a break fails the test; entries may only be removed.
